description: Write edited pages back to a website in one call — the counterpart to export_site. Pass the pages you changed (each with id + the full blocks array; optional title/slug). Only the pages you send are updated; unchanged pages can be omitted. Each page is applied independently and reported in results, so one failure does not abort the rest. Always start from an export_site snapshot so you keep the blocks you are not changing.

blocks.description: Full blocks array to set on this page
